_comment: Tiles the game's world-map converter refuses: a marker there is never drawn (the engine answers 'cannot convert' and the DLL skips it), so generate_data.py drops the rows instead of baking them. Keyed by profile ('*' = every profile). Never a whole vanilla area: 'm32_*' would take the tunnels (m32_00..m32_11) with it - Golden Age's custom maps are the HIGH grid numbers of areas 32 and 46, listed one by one. 'm32_*' = whole area, 'm32_68' = that tile (gz 00), 'm32_68_01' = a specific tile. Source of truth is the [v3native] projection summary the DLL logs at CATEGORIES READY: add a tile only after it shows up there.
